faqs.question: How do I know this screen fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits most 15.6" slim-bezel laptops using a 30-pin or 40-pin connector at FHD resolution. If you're unsure, send us your laptop model or a photo of the current screen's connector on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: No, this is a non-touch panel. We also stock an HD non-touch version.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
